cases.detail: Xezim 0.11.4 returns code zero but writes "No error" into the description for a successful file operation, including packed buffers. IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.7 explicitly requires the description to be cleared when the most recent operation did not produce an error. Icarus 13.0 and Celox clear both output forms; the standalone probe prints the difference.
cases.name: file_io::ferror_success_clears_description

cases.detail: xezim version 0.11.4 suppresses file monitoring after $monitoroff. IEEE 1800-2023 21.3.2 gives file monitors independent lists and no on/off counterparts. The standalone FileMonitor probe prints no file lines; Icarus and Celox print file=0 and file=1.
cases.name: file_io::fmonitor_is_independent_of_console_monitor_off

cases.detail: xezim version 0.11.4 misses a monitor display after a variable changes and returns to its previous value within one slot. IEEE 1800-2023 21.2.3 requires output when an argument changes. The standalone Transient probe prints one line instead of two; Icarus and Celox print both.
cases.name: file_io::monitor_reports_transient_changes

cases.detail: xezim 0.11.4 in the configured suite prints t=2000 at 2ns for a monitored $time in the 1ns source scope, where IEEE 1800-2023 20.3.1 requires t=2. The standalone TimeQueryBench probe prints t=2 correctly; this exclusion is specific to the suite configuration, which stages timescale/source/testbench as separate files. The unchanged case still requires direct time queries not to trigger output.
cases.name: file_io::monitor_time_queries_do_not_trigger_output
